label: About
title: About The Face That Turns Into Weather
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from a saved source, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: a visible mark in the scene opens the real source that shaped the day.

This edition began with one saved post, @hayato_hanabusa: 変容. Its image from pbs.twimg.com set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became The Face That Turns Into Weather: Transfiguring meadow sky painted on torn sketchbook paper: wide horizon-band composition, flat frontal plate, horizon low. One enormous olive-khaki eye with a thick crescent pupil hovers right of center in cloud-white haze; its twin melts into a soft gray smudge far left across open sky. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped the source to Olive-khaki crescent-pupil eye floating in cloud-white sky.
